citations.quote: A measure that captures the value added to book value is residual earnings or residual income.
The residual earnings value for a terminal project is always the same as that calculated with discounted cash flow methods.
If the issuing company is assumed to be a going concern, the intrinsic value of a share is the present value of expected future dividends.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Framing residual-earnings valuation as the accounting-anchored equity-value framework: intrinsic value = book value + PV of future residual earnings, where residual earnings = NI − r × BV_prev. The justified P/B drops out as a corollary; the accounting-policy invariance property makes the framework robust to choice.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Residual Earnings Valuation
